metadata.limits: Only verified rule rows are actionable for condition-specific preliminary concentration screening. No row does NOT imply unrestricted. The KR/CN pages are source leads only, not ingredient-level legal verification. US sunscreen entries belong to OTC drug law.
metadata.scope_codes: Scope strings are descriptive, not an exhaustive legal ontology. If an exact fit cannot be established, manual review required.
